likelyRejectionReasons: A second details control remains visible or the whole card is not actually clickable.
Phone or WhatsApp is swallowed by the stretched card link.
Breadcrumbs link to a generic or empty hourly page instead of the place region.
The detail page is only recolored and still lacks the room-oriented hierarchy of vacation pages.
Mobile room cards or rate chips overflow or become difficult to scan.
earliestMidpoint: Source tests for card interaction, breadcrumb hierarchy and hourly room-card structure before visual verification.
adversarialClose: Exercise card body, gallery, favorite, phone and WhatsApp separately; inspect the same hourly detail at desktop and 390px; compare visible and structured breadcrumbs.
